proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5523.3 *dag gives Lahnda dagg, Punjabi dagaṛ and Hindi dagṛā road. The dental-initial survey forms select this branch rather than retroflex *ḍag; regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form dagaḍa is preserved.
